_how_to_fill_this_in: Your group, formed in this lecture, for the rest of the term: the 9-digit student numbers of all its members, your own included.

Every member of the group writes exactly the same list; the order does not matter. After the lecture I compare the lists of all members. If they are not the same, every member of the group loses one point of the end-of-lecture mark.
A group has four members. If the class does not divide into fours, the students left over join a group, which then has five members: write all five numbers.

meeting: optional. Your group does not meet every week; each assignment says in which weeks it meets and what for. If you like, write how your group reaches each other, for example 'WhatsApp group' or 'Discord'.
You may delete this block once you have read it; the checker ignores it.
